The bug: `merge_incoming` concatenates existing + incoming and runs unique_fn over everything. On first load, existing is empty, so it should just return incoming without dedupe — or at least the merge strategy should be "incoming" mode: when existing is empty, skip uniquing entirely (snapshot had no rows, so nothing to unique against). The fix: merge_incoming should only unique the incoming against existing, not re-dedupe the incoming itself.
